name: Abrahamic
blurb: Traditions tracing themselves to the God of Abraham: Judaism, Christianity, Islam and the faiths that grew from them.

name: Indian (Dharmic)
blurb: Traditions born on the Indian subcontinent around ideas of dharma, karma and release: Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, Sikhism.

name: East Asian
blurb: Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese traditions of ancestors, the Dao, kami and ritual order.

name: Iranian
blurb: Traditions of the Iranian plateau and Mesopotamia: Zoroastrianism, Manichaeism, Yazidism.

name: Ancient Near East & Mediterranean
blurb: The temple religions of Sumer, Egypt, Canaan, Greece and Rome, all now ended as public cults.

name: Northern & Celtic Europe
blurb: Germanic, Norse, Celtic, Slavic and Baltic religions, and the modern movements that revive them.

name: Indigenous Americas
blurb: Maya, Mexica and Inca religion, and the Native American Church.

name: Africa & diaspora
blurb: West African orisha and vodun traditions, and the religions they became in the Caribbean and Brazil.
